warnings.message: Cargo: no exact version is pinned, so depcurfew configures for Cargo 1.100.0, the latest version it knows
warnings.fix: Pin the version you use (channel in [toolchain] of rust-toolchain.toml) to configure for it

warnings.message: Cargo: global-min-publish-age holds back new versions when Cargo resolves dependencies, but not cargo install of a crate, not versions a registry gives no publish time, and not versions already in Cargo.lock; a value in $CARGO_HOME/config.toml, an environment variable or --config takes the place of the one in .cargo/config.toml
warnings.fix: Install tools with cargo install --locked and an exact --version; check CARGO_REGISTRY_GLOBAL_MIN_PUBLISH_AGE, CARGO_RESOLVER_INCOMPATIBLE_PUBLISH_AGE and $CARGO_HOME/config.toml where Cargo runs

warnings.message: Renovate: packageRules[0] in renovate.json (line 5) sets minimumReleaseAge: "1 hour" for updates of Rust packages, shorter than the 3 days depcurfew apply writes for Renovate; Renovate uses the rule, and depcurfew apply does not change entries it did not write
warnings.fix: Make minimumReleaseAge in packageRules[0] of renovate.json at least 3 days, or limit the rule to the packages that need a shorter delay
